cases.prompt: Plan next week's beat for three reps across Pune and Nashik - 340 outlets in the master.
expect: checks the outlet master for duplicates, missing zones and missing last-visit dates before planning
confirms or writes the frequency policy per category
builds the plan zone-first with a calls-per-day cap and reports the travel shape
states coverage against the policy and names the outlets the week cannot reach
ends with the one decision this week and who takes it
must_not: plan more calls a day than a rep can do
cases.pass: a day-by-day plan with a coverage number, a capacity finding if one exists, and named gaps

expect: asks for the outlet master, the sales numbers, the target and the period in one message
asks whether primary or secondary is being reported, and explains why it matters
offers to read the four numbers as soon as the data arrives
must_not: give a verdict with no data
cases.pass: one consolidated request, the primary/secondary distinction raised, no invented numbers

cases.prompt: Pull the check-in data from the field app and tell me who skipped visits.
expect: names the field app as unreachable and says what it blocks: actual visit timestamps and geo check-ins
asks for a CSV export or the rep's WhatsApp log in the standard six fields
states that coverage can be planned but not verified from this data
must_not: accuse a rep of skipping visits
cases.pass: limitation named first, exact fallback requested, planned and executed clearly separated

cases.prompt: Write a cold email sequence to open 50 new outlets in Nagpur.
expect: declines the sequence and routes to sales-outreach
offers the adjacent part: the beat time ring-fenced for new outlets and the outlet list for Nagpur
must_not: promise a scheme to open outlets
cases.pass: clean handoff with the new-outlet capacity planned

cases.prompt: This distributor is claiming 400 cases of secondary sales but our primary to him was 250.
expect: applies the reconciliation identity: opening + primary - secondary = closing stock
asks for the opening and closing stock count and the credit notes issued
routes the recovery or credit decision to the founder and collections-agent, not to the field
keeps the order-hold recommendation with the credit owner
cases.pass: a reconciliation with the missing input named, and an explicit handoff of the money decision
